input_contract: Camera A RGB + Camera A K + identical dataset ROI

surface_budget.normalization: mean within each view, then mean across views

update_order: For each seed, independently shuffle all 180 frozen TRAIN rows once per cycle using SHA256(seed:update-order:cycle) into numpy PCG64; concatenate three cycles. S/M with the same seed use an identical order. Resume verifies the full-order SHA256.
selection_rule: Within each arm select the lowest subject-equal absolute camera-space surface error on fixed VAL, subject to no severe P90/P95 or coverage reversal. Compare S/M by the median trend across paired seeds. Translation-aligned is diagnostic only.
